image_manifest.description: A high-fidelity 3D animated game screen for a naming quiz, featuring a group of diverse pterosaurs gathered around a paleontologist referee in a coastal environment.

text_elements.style: Blue and yellow stylized 3D block letters with soft shadows

characters.name: Paleontologist Referee
characters.description: A male paleontologist with dark hair and tan skin, wearing signature thin-rimmed black circular glasses. He is dressed in a black-and-white striped referee jersey under a khaki safari vest, holding a large wooden pointer.

characters.name: Tupandactylus
characters.description: A colorful pterosaur in the foreground with a massive, vibrant multi-colored iridescent head crest, looking towards the referee.

characters.name: Pterodaustro
characters.description: A pterosaur on the left characterized by its unique, upward-curving filter-feeding beak, standing attentively.

characters.name: Tapejara
characters.description: A pterosaur on the right with a large, rounded vertical head crest, rendered with high-fidelity skin textures.

characters.name: Dimorphodon
characters.description: A smaller pterosaur with a puffin-like deep beak perched near the group.

environment_and_props.presentation_board: A large, rustic wooden chalkboard standing on the sand, displaying a silhouette of a pterosaur used for the guessing game.
environment_and_props.pointer: A long wooden stick held by the referee to indicate the board.
environment_and_props.background: A tropical Solnhofen coastal setting with white carbonate sand, turquoise water, and a light blue sky with wispy clouds.
environment_and_props.watermark: A small, translucent four-pointed star flare in the bottom-right corner.
